item.title: Remains found 49 years ago in North Carolina identified as teen runaway
item.description: Skeletal remains found in North Carolina in 1977 have been identified as those of Cindy Marcell Blizzard, a 15-year-old girl who ran away from her home in Monkton, Maryland, investigators said.

item.title: Michigan Jewish leaders call on El-Sayed to change posture on Israel
item.description: A coalition of Michigan Jewish leaders launched a petition calling on Abdul El-Sayed and other political candidates to make baseline commitments on Jewish safety and Israel, or risk losing their support.

item.title: Patrick Clancy's lawyer threatens conspiracy theorists with legal action
item.description: Patrick Clancy, Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband, issued a scathing statement to conspiracy theorists who have been claiming he was involved in the deaths of the couple's children - "There will be consequences."

item.title: U.S. forces hit Iran-linked oil tankers as oil nears $100 a barrel
item.description: Oil prices are rising steadily with no end in sight to the U.S.-Iran standoff impeding tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy juror speaks after mistrial: "There was so much doubt"
item.description: A woman who served as a juror in Lindsay Clancy's high-profile Massachusetts murder trial provided a look at deliberations, saying there was too much doubt for her to reach a guilty verdict.

item.title: Victims identified in deadly plane crash at Miami International Airport
item.description: The Amazon cargo plane crashed off the end of a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, leaving five people dead and five others injured.

item.title: Judge orders bond increase for Barry Morphew after arrest
item.description: A Colorado judge ordered an increase in bond for murder suspect Barry Morphew on Tuesday from $3 million to $10 million cash only.

item.title: NYC officials release unseen post-9/11 air quality documents
item.description: New York City officials released thousands of previously unseen documents questioning the air quality at Ground Zero following the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: With midterms less than 60 days out, these are the Senate races to watch
item.description: Tuesday marks 56 days until the midterm elections, where the balance of power of the U.S. Congress hangs in the balance. CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto and Sabato's Crystal Ball managing editor Kyle Kondik join with analysis.

item.title: New documents suggest New York City officials misled residents about air quality after 9/11 attacks
item.description: New York City officials have released thousands of unseen documents on the air quality at Ground Zero after the 9/11 attacks. The documents reveal more evidence that concerns about the air persisted for months after the attacks, despite officials assuring the public the area was safe. New York Times reporter Sally Goldenberg joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Lithuanian civilians, including children, training for possible Russian attacks
item.description: Lithuania is preparing citizens in case the Russia-Ukraine war spreads to their country. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has the latest.

item.title: Supreme Court rebuffs Missouri's request for new House map favoring GOP
item.description: It's a defeat for Republicans who had hoped the new map could help them hold on to their slim House majority.

item.title: First-ever Republican midterm convention set to spotlight Ken Paxton and Texas Senate race
item.description: Republicans are gathering in Dallas, Texas, ahead of their first-ever midterm convention that kicks off Wednesday. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs could most harm states key for Senate control
item.description: Canada's steep retaliatory tariffs against the U.S. took effect early Tuesday morning. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes has the details.

item.title: SEC files lawsuit against LSU over football eligibility
item.description: The Southeastern Conference filed a lawsuit against Louisiana State University after the school added former NFL players to its roster, claiming the NCAA owes them a fifth year of collegiate eligibility. CBS Sports national college sports reporter John Talty, has more.

item.title: Why some key GOP candidates are skipping Trump-backed midterm convention
item.description: President Trump and top GOP leaders are gathering in Dallas for a midterm convention, though some Republicans in competitive races are opting to skip it and campaign in their home districts or states.

item.title: Ground zero responders recount their haunting 9/11 experiences | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Dr. Benjamin Luft, who helped launch a clinic to treat 9/11 responders, also worked to record the history of ground zero with the World Trade Center Oral History Project.

item.title: Bombardier caught in the crossfire of escalating U.S.-Canada feud
item.description: President Trump threatened to ban Bombardier sales in the U.S. as Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect. Here's what to know about the aircraft maker.

item.title: TSA program will allow some people to go through security without a ticket
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration has launched a new program at 13 airports, allowing eligible TSA PreCheck members without plane tickets to pass through security and enter the gates.

item.title: Lowell lashes Hawaii, knocking out power to thousands as flood risk continues
item.description: Fierce winds downed trees and caused widespread power outages on the island of Kauai, home to 73,000 residents.

item.title: U.S. Marshals find 79 missing children across Ohio in historic operation
item.description: The U.S. Marshals Service announced that it found 79 missing and endangered children across Ohio in August. The Marshals Service worked with federal, state and local partners to find the children during Operation Meridian. CBS News' Anna Schecter has more.

item.title: Trump and Putin held call over Witkoff-Kushner meeting and state of Ukraine war, Russia says
item.description: Russian officials reported on Tuesday that President Trump had a call with Vladimir Putin over a visit to Moscow by U.S. peace envoys. CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: OpenAI launches new Astra model with warning that it may attempt to evade human monitoring
item.description: OpenAI has launched it's new artificial intelligence model, Astra. Greg Bensinger, technology reporter with Reuters, joins CBS News to discuss the new model.

item.title: Inside a harrowing escape from the World Trade Center on 9/11 | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: A bank employee, who was on the 78th floor of the south tower, and a Morgan Stanley executive, who was on the 70th floor, share the miraculous tale of their escape to safety on 9/11.

item.title: Apple event expected to debut foldable iPhone and new CEO John Ternus
item.description: Apple's Sept. 9 tech showcase is set to feature new CEO John Ternus unveiling its first foldable iPhone and the iPhone 18.

item.title: Operator of plane in Miami crash had prior safety complaints by former employees
item.description: The Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 cargo plane that crashed off a Miami runway​ on Sunday, killing five people, was operated by a North Carolina company that has been accused by past employees of violating safety regulations, legal documents reveal.

item.title: Dangerous Hurricane Lowell passing just west of Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Lowell was skirting western Hawaii, bringing damaging winds, heavy rain and punishing waves, the National Hurricane Center said.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow use of citizenship database
item.description: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court to intervene in a lawsuit over the use of a controversial data system to review state voter rolls.

item.title: Goldman Sachs warns oil prices could hit $120 as U.S. fuel costs surge
item.description: Higher gas and diesel prices have cost Americans an additional $100 billion since the Iran war began, according to a Brown University tracker.

item.title: Witness says pilot in Amazon crash was shaking afterward: "My career is over"
item.description: Abraham Altamar was on the phone with his wife when he briefly spoke with one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that overran a runway in Miami.
